decisions: Record Bithomp's two public account pages as conflicting secondary explorer observations, not proof that the escrow objects are absent.
Preserve XRP Insights' pinned-ledger #108031214 claim as a separate source; do not treat its raw JSON-RPC methodology statement as independently verified by this run.
Keep the November 1 1B XRP event classified as scheduled FinishAfter eligibility reported by XRP Insights; current raw account-object state remains unverified.
Do not issue a directional forecast or admit escrow-supply features until the discrepancy is resolved at a common validated ledger.
Preserve the Bithomp source revision as pending archive append; do not overwrite prior escrow snapshots.
required_verification: Retrieve account_objects(type=escrow) for both owner accounts at ledger_index 108031214 from an authorized public XRPL node.
Retrieve account_tx for both accounts and verify the four October 1 EscrowFinish hashes and metadata.
At the current validated ledger, verify the two November 1 escrow objects' Owner, Destination, Amount, FinishAfter, CancelAfter and ledger object indexes.
After 00:00 UTC, verify actual EscrowFinish transaction hashes and subsequent EscrowCreate/disposition.
